title: Whispering Whelk Waltzer
statement: A pearly spiral-shelled snail the size of a teacup, she glides in slow figure-eights through a lantern-lit tank of drifting moss and amber sand, humming tiny bubbles that rise like a song nobody asked for but everyone needed. Each time she passes her favorite sunken teapot, she pauses to bow, trailing a ribbon of glowing plankton behind her.
